adds.title: Movement Advancement Project - Colorado's Equality Profile
adds.summary: As of October 12, 2026, Colorado law prohibited gender-identity discrimination in housing and public accommodations, reflecting a high gender-identity policy score of 23.25/25 within a high overall score of 44.5/47.

adds.title: H.B. No. 7006 - Birth Certificate Gender Marker Law
adds.summary: On June 1 2015 the Connecticut Senate voted 32-3 to send a bill to Governor Dannel P Malloy allowing any person who has undergone surgical, hormonal or other clinically appropriate treatment for gender transition to change sex on their birth certificate replacing the prior sex reassignment surgery requirement after House passage
